name: Luneta Dorm Residence
address: Ermita, Manila (near Luneta Park and LRT, Taft Avenue area)
description: Segregated male and female dormitory in Ermita offering everything from solo cubicles to large bunk quarters. Rooms are mostly air-conditioned and a front desk watches the premises around the clock. Handy for students heading to nearby Taft-area campuses who want a low-cost bunk.

name: Harvard Suites (Taft Avenue Bedspace)
address: 2632 Taft Ave, Malate, Manila, beside LRT-1 Quirino Station
description: Fully furnished four-bed dorm unit in a Taft Avenue condo building, a short walk from DLSU, Benilde, St. Scholastica's and UP-PGH. Building perks include a pool, gym and study hub. Contract is a minimum of six months with no curfew.
houseRules: No curfew. Minimum 6-month contract. No pets. No smoking.

name: Natividad Lopez Student Dorm (Suzy 679)
address: 1129 Natividad Lopez St, Ermita, Manila, near LRT Central Station and SM Manila
description: Student-focused dorm in Ermita close to Adamson, Mapua, LPU and PLM. Offers four-person bedspace rooms and two-person twin rooms with their own bathroom. Shared spaces include a common kitchen, study hub and roof deck.
houseRules: Electricity split by consumption among roommates; water and admin fee of 112 pesos per person monthly.

name: Taft Dorm near UP Manila, PGH (Ramagi Bldg)
address: Ramagi Bldg, Pedro Gil St, Ermita, Manila, near LRT Pedro Gil
description: Budget dorm along Pedro Gil near UP Manila and PGH with both air-conditioned and fan rooms. Rooms come with cabinets, shelves and desk space, and a study hall is available. Water is free and a generator covers brownouts.
houseRules: 2 months deposit plus 1 month advance. Minimum stay of 1 month.

name: Singalong Dormitory Malate (Suzy 549)
address: 2181 Fermin Street, Singalong, Malate, Manila, walking distance to LRT Quirino
description: Furnished dorm on Fermin Street with rooms for one to six or more people, rentable by day, week or month. Rooms are either centrally air-conditioned or fan-cooled. Jeepneys, markets and food spots are nearby.
houseRules: Security deposit required. Post-dated cheques required. Electricity for appliances charged extra.

name: Gen. Malvar Bedspace for Men (Suzy 848)
address: 1004 Gen. Malvar St, Malate, Manila, near PGH and Paco
description: Shared bedspace for male students and workers in Malate, with each tenant assigned a bed in a four-bed room. Rent already covers electricity, water and Wi-Fi. The building has a pool, gym and roof deck.
houseRules: No curfew. No pets. No smoking.

name: Green Residences Girls Bedspace (Suzy 432)
address: 2428 Leon Guinto Street, Malate, Manila (Green Residences, Taft Ave, near DLSU)
description: Girls-only bedspace inside the Green Residences tower beside DLSU. Wi-Fi and water are covered by the rent, and tenants can use the building's pool, gym and study hub. Requires a one-year lease and proof of enrollment.
houseRules: 1-year minimum lease. School ID and certificate of enrollment required. 2-month deposit.
